title: perf(hitsPerPageSelector): Use the correct lodash function

comments.body: I don't care about perf, but it's more readable :+1:
Actually, that's the conventional changelog tag that fitted best with the commit I think. Should I use `style` in this kind of cases?

> Should I use style in this kind of cases?

I think both are fine, I would personally go for either `style` or `chore` I think.
We can use "perf" if we actually made any siginficant perf improvment (and measured it).
